candidate_relations.reason: Cutaneous angiosarcoma is a malignant vascular sarcoma, not this bland lobular tufted angioma.
Cutaneous collateral vessel formation is a physiologic vascular response, not a neoplastic tufted angioma.
Atypical vascular lesion is a vague vascular-proliferation parent, not tufted angioma with KDR mutation.
Benign vascular tumor is the parent category missing tufted angioma and KDR.
Kaposiform hemangioendothelioma is the related aggressive end of the tufted-angioma spectrum, an incompatible subtype here.
Bacillary angiomatosis is an infectious angioproliferation, not a KDR-mutant tufted angioma.
The plaque is composed of telangiectasias clinically, a morphologic descriptor rather than tufted angioma.
Telangiectasia macularis eruptiva perstans is a mastocytosis variant, not tufted angioma.
KRAS wild-type rectal adenocarcinoma is the underlying malignancy, not the shin vascular tumor.
Somatic KDR (VEGFR2) mutation is the molecular component without naming tufted angioma.
Known liver metastases are oncologic history, not the cutaneous diagnosis.
Angiokeratoma is a different ectatic vascular lesion.
Epidermolysis bullosa is a blistering genodermatosis unrelated to this plaque.
Microvenular hemangioma is a distinct bland vascular tumor, not tufted angioma.
Superficial basal cell carcinoma is epithelial, not vascular.
Radiation-induced telangiectasia asserts a different cause; the lesion is a KDR-mutant tufted angioma on the shin.
Chemotherapy-induced vascular lesion asserts a toxic etiology rather than a somatic KDR-mutant tufted angioma.
Tufted angioma matches the histology but omits the somatic KDR mutation required by the reference.
Rectal adenocarcinoma with metastases is the cancer history, not the vascular tumor.
Pulmonary metastases are known stage-IV disease, not tufted angioma.

case_quality_flags: Histology of tufted small-caliber vessels plus somatic KDR p.T771R; no candidate combines tufted angioma with the KDR mutation.
